mostWorthwhile.text: Linking the stores’ controls was the most worthwhile action: it brought the separate liquefaction paths together into an operating fuel fab while explaining that the propellants remain isolated.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the two tanks was straightforward and somewhat repetitive, although their distinct gas paths made physical sense.

surprise.text: I initially expected fitting the cooling units to equip both tanks, but the result also explained the protective housings, individual heat rejection and keyed fittings. That made the safety design more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; linking the two tank objects represented coordinating their controls, not physically connecting their contents.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the return and delivery of the preserved samples unfold; the fuel-fab sequence made useful engineering distinctions, even if its individual choices were fairly obvious.
